+title: Add defaultWorkingDirectory to ShellCapability.init and withShell
+---
+## What
+Ask 6, part 2 (UPSTREAM_ASKS.md). Expose the runner default on the public composition, so a host gives the session root one time and each plain command lands there.
+
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Capabilities/Shell/ShellCapability.swift`: add a fourth parameter `defaultWorkingDirectory: URL? = nil` to `public init(storeDirectory:sandbox:outputChunkStream:)`. Give `runner.defaultWorkingDirectory = defaultWorkingDirectory?.path`. Document: the directory a `tools.shell.execute` call runs in when it omits `workingDirectory`; the default, `nil`, keeps the current directory of this process; a host with a session root passes that root. Update the doc comment that says "the same three arguments" to four.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Surface/MultiToolBuilder.swift`: add the same parameter to `withShell(storeDirectory:sandbox:outputChunkStream:)` and pass it through. Update the doc list of parameters and the `MultiToolBuilderError` header comment that names the `withShell` signature.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Capabilities/Shell/Execute.swift`:
+  - The `@Guide` text of `ExecuteArguments.workingDirectory` (line 92) becomes "The directory the command runs in. Omit it to run in the session's working directory."
+  - The verb `description` (line 785) keeps "workingDirectory to run it somewhere else".
+  - The doc comment of `ExecuteArguments.workingDirectory` (line 88-89) names the runner default.
+- Search for every other text that states the old fallback ("Omit it to run in the current directory", "the current directory of this process") in `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Capabilities/Shell/` and correct it.
+- Search `IntegrationTests/` for a doc comment that names the three-argument `withShell` signature (`Support/ShellRunContextProbe.swift:24`) and correct it. Do not change the integration tests' behavior.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `ShellCapability(storeDirectory:defaultWorkingDirectory:)` gives an `Execute` verb whose `runner.defaultWorkingDirectory` is the path of the URL.
+- [ ] `MultiTool.Builder().withShell(storeDirectory:defaultWorkingDirectory:)` renders the same three verbs, and the `execute` verb in `registry.tools["shell.execute"]` carries the default.
+- [ ] A `tools.shell.execute` call that omits `workingDirectory`, run through a capability with a default, prints the resolved default from `pwd`.
+- [ ] The Ask 6 scenario passes: a `SeatbeltSandbox(options: .init(writableRoots: [root]))` where `root` is a temporary directory, a capability with `defaultWorkingDirectory: root`, and an `execute` call with no `workingDirectory` and command `pwd`. The result carries no correction (no "outside the configured roots" text), and the output is the resolved root. Before this change the same call is refused.
+- [ ] The default `nil` keeps every existing shell test green.
+- [ ] The rendered surface text of `tools.shell.execute` (goldens under `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/Goldens`, if one covers the shell) is updated to the new `@Guide` text, and `swift test` is green.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Add to `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/ShellCapabilityTests.swift`: `theDefaultWorkingDirectoryReachesTheRunner` and `withShellPassesTheDefaultWorkingDirectoryThrough`.
+- [ ] Add to `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/ShellExecuteTests.swift`: `executeWithNoWorkingDirectoryRunsInTheCapabilityDefault` (bare call, no session; read `pwd` from the report or from `GetLines`).
+- [ ] Add to `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/SandboxPreflightTests.swift` (or `SeatbeltSandboxTests.swift`, whichever already spawns `sandbox-exec`): `aPlainCommandUnderASandboxRootedAtTheDefaultIsNotRefused`, the Ask 6 scenario above. Guard it the same way the other seatbelt tests are guarded when `sandbox-exec` is not available.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter "Shell|Sandbox|Renderer"` and expect every test to pass. Then run the whole `swift test` and expect it green.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
